snippet.title: Failed State - Prototype Trailer | Indie Political Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Welcome to Failed State - a darkly satirical indie political strategy game where your every decision shapes a nation's destiny. In this official trailer, experience the tension of leading a country on the brink of collapse. Will you guide your nation to stability, or let chaos reign?

Key Features:
• Indie Game | Political Strategy | Dark Satire
• Navigate politics, diplomacy, and survival
• Make high-stakes decisions in a crumbling state
